title: One-Winged Angel (Advent Children)
artist: Nobuo Uematsu / The Black Mages (Final Fantasy VII)

drums.tags: Acoustic drum solo. The performance features a dry, punchy snare drum, a resonant kick drum, and crisp hi-hats. The rhythm is built on a syncopated funk-rock groove at 115 BPM in 4/4 time. The drummer utilizes ghost notes on the snare and open hi-hat accents on the off-beats. The kick drum follows a double-stroke pattern. The recording has a close-mic proximity with minimal room reverb, emphasizing the transient attack of the sticks.
